convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMFI indicator with standard parameters. Simple crossover entry/exit logic. Fixed lot position sizing. No external libraries or custom indicators. Straightforward MFI-based strategy.

other_exits: Close long position when MFI crosses below LowLevel
Close short position when MFI crosses above HighLevel

custom_logic_notes: MFI oscillator strategy with configurable overbought/oversold threshold levels (HighLevel default ~80, LowLevel default ~20). Signal reversal close logic: opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one. Uses IsNewBar pattern to evaluate signals only once per completed bar using previous bar MFI values ([1] and [2]) to confirm crossover/crossunder.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. MFI is available in most Python TA libraries (ta-lib, pandas-ta). The crossover logic on previous bars maps directly to comparing MFI[1] vs threshold and MFI[2] vs threshold. Fixed SL/TP in pips requires symbol-specific pip value calculation. The new bar guard translates to checking if bar timestamp has changed. Position gate logic (close opposite before entering) maps to checking current open positions and closing before opening new.
